title: Senior AI Architect
description:
Senior AI Architect - UK (Remote) - Agentic AI, Gen AI & Enterprise AI -Up to £105,000

I'm working with a growing technology consultancy that is investing heavily in its AI capabilities and looking to appoint a senior AI leader to shape and deliver enterprise-scale Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions across highly regulated environments.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in defining AI strategy, leading technical delivery, and building production-grade AI systems that move beyond proof of concept into real-world business impact.

The Role

You'll lead the architecture and delivery of complex AI solutions, working with senior stakeholders to identify opportunities, define roadmaps, and implement scalable AI platforms.

The role combines deep technical expertise with leadership responsibilities, making it ideal for someone who enjoys remaining hands-on while influencing AI strategy at an organisational level.

You'll be responsible for:

  • Designing and delivering production-ready Agentic AI and Generative AI solutions
  • Leading architecture decisions across AI, data, cloud and MLOps environments
  • Building multi-agent systems, RAG frameworks and LLM-powered applications
  • Driving AI governance, observability and Responsible AI best practices
  • Advising senior business and technology leaders on AI adoption strategies
  • Mentoring engineers, data scientists and AI specialists
  • Helping define AI strategy, best practices and the future direction of a growing AI capability.

What We're Looking For

We're interested in speaking with experienced AI Architects, Principal AI Engineers, AI Practice Leads, Head of AI professionals, or similar senior technical leaders who have successfully delivered enterprise AI solutions.

Key experience includes:

Essential

  • Strong background in Agentic AI and Generative AI
  • Experience building and deploying LLM-based applications in production
  • Enterprise AI architecture and technical leadership experience
  • MLOps / LLMOps expertise
  • Strong engineering foundations with Python and cloud-native technologies
  • Experience working with Azure, AWS or GCP
  • Commercial experience delivering AI solutions at scale
  • Ability to engage with both technical and executive stakeholders

Desirable

  • Experience working within Financial Services, Insurance or other highly regulated environments would be advantageous.
  • Databricks, MLflow and modern AI platform experience
  • LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen or similar frameworks
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures
  • Multi-agent orchestration platforms
  • Responsible AI and governance experience

Why Join?

  • Join a business making significant investment in AI and emerging technologies
  • Work on genuinely innovative Agentic AI and GenAI initiatives
  • Influence AI strategy for complex enterprise organisations
  • Lead high-impact programmes from concept through to production
  • Flexible hybrid/remote working
  • Excellent career progression opportunities as the AI practice expands
  • Ongoing investment in learning, certifications and professional development
  • Collaborative, entrepreneurial environment where your ideas can shape the future direction of the business

Package

  • Remote Working
  • Private Healthcare
  • Life Assurance
  • Learning & Development Budget
  • Clear Career Progression Path


If you're passionate about building enterprise-scale AI solutions and want to influence the next generation of Agentic AI and Generative AI platforms, we'd love to hear from you.
